title: What's streaming this week
canadaNote: In Canada, HBO Max and Peacock titles usually stream on Crave, and Hulu originals usually go to Disney+. Where a Canadian release isn't confirmed, we say so.

outToday.title: The Altruists
outToday.availability: U.S. and Canada, all episodes at once. JustWatch Canada lists it.
outToday.summary: Julia Garner and Anthony Boyle play Caroline Ellison and Sam Bankman-Fried in a dramatized account of the rise and collapse of the FTX crypto exchange. Barack and Michelle Obama are executive producers.

outToday.title: The Pursuit: F1 Academy
outToday.summary: A 42-minute documentary following drivers Doriane Pin, Maya Weug, Chloe Chambers and Alisha Palmowski through the 2025 season of F1 Academy, the all-women junior racing series.

outToday.title: The Assassin
outToday.availability: U.S., new episodes weekly through Dec. 24. Canadian timing not confirmed.
outToday.summary: Keeley Hawes returns as retired hitwoman Julie, who reluctantly teams up with her son again when a new threat crashes his honeymoon.

outToday.title: Nelly & Ashanti: We Belong Together
outToday.availability: U.S. Crave date in Canada not confirmed.
outToday.summary: The married music couple juggle family, careers and their legacy.

outToday.title: A Cherry Pie Christmas
outToday.summary: A holiday film starring Katie Leclerc.

recent.title: Mike Ward: Modest
recent.summary: The Quebec comic's first French-language Netflix special, filmed at Théâtre Manuvie in Brossard, Que.

recent.title: Vienna Game
recent.availability: Hulu in the U.S.; a Disney+ original outside the U.S., so look on Disney+ in Canada.
recent.summary: A German-language historical comedy-drama about diplomatic power games in Vienna, with subtitles.

recent.title: Valentina and the 12 Signs
recent.availability: Netflix original (Brazil); normally a worldwide launch.
recent.summary: A heartbroken woman decides to date one man from every sign of the zodiac.

recent.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
recent.availability: U.S. Canadian release not confirmed; Hulu originals usually go to Disney+ in Canada.
recent.summary: A spinoff of Hulu's Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, set among a new circle of young women in Orange County. All eight episodes are out.
